- docs/notes/invariant-policy.md line 13: "Bid cap | 0.001"
- README.md line 31: "Bid cap (default 0.001)"

- internal/config/config.go line 55: env default "0.01"
- deploy/deployment.yaml line 38: WARDEN_MAX_BID_PRICE "0.01" with note "Spot raised the gp.vs1.medium floor to 0.01/hr (was 0.001); verified via serverclasses API 2026-07-27"
